notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content: [p]The second feature update for Pivot of Hearts is here! The highlight this time is something players have been asking since the early days after release: [b]the art gallery![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]About the gallery[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41615395/5bef996586f3670a59497c2a136e257e65a8c5ec.png"][/img][/p][p]In the gallery — which we placed under the "Extra" option along with the "Achievements" menu — you can revisit your favorite moments across Wen's journey. Leaf through all the game's original background and CG art, vibe to the unforgettable tunes that give life to the story, fool around with the character voice overs, and re-watch the opening animation to your heart's content! We even added the amazing promotional art showcased during the launch campaign, made by our incredible guest artists![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41615395/3bdca2a763a92fb2b027cd45dc568cfbeaad800e.png"][/img][/p][p]Some of the sections in the gallery will unlock content as you play the game, while others unlock all at once after reaching one of the good endings for the first time. This means you have a great excuse to play Pivot of Hearts many times more![/p][p][/p][h2]Full changelog[/h2][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p]Gallery with arts, sounds, and movies[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list][*][p]Number of save slots to 80 (from 50)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixed[/h3][list][*][p]Missing CG unlock during Blast Bros Bonanza[/p][/*][*][p]Minor mistakes in a few BGs and CGs[/p][/*][*][p]Many typos, grammatical errors, etc.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
This is the first feature update of Pivot of Hearts! We still have lots of planned features for the game, especially regarding accessibility. We hope to keep these updates coming in small steps but often, so stay tuned!

For this particular update, here is what is new in Pivot of Hearts:

[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Autosave support
[*] Message after the ending informing when a new route is unlocked
[*] A few more translation/cultural notes
[*] SFX for Sigur's vicious mockery cantrip
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Many typos, grammatical errors, etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo patch 0.12.2
notes.content:
Hello, dragonrollers! Expect some more news in the near future but, for now, here's a quick patch based on our latest advances in the full game:

[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Preference options to disable quick flash visual effects
[*] Support for translating phone chat title and clock display

[*] Character chibis in phone chats after meeting them once
[*] English dialogue and Japanese lyrics proofreader to credits
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]

[list]
[*] English proofreading
[*] Dialogue beep SFX so it no longer ducks
[*] Sigurd's birth name is no longer undesired, only a lesser preference
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Focus effect resetting sprite expression
[*] Crash when using focus effect on sprites not shown
[*] Title menu options being clickable while showing sub-menus
[*] Suit icons being misaligned in some resolutions
[*] Undesired dissolve effect when showing or hiding card panel
[*] A few sprites with minor issues
[*] All text formatting
[*] Assorted typos
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update 0.12.0
notes.content:
It has been a while but... This is probably the last major update before the full release of the Pivot of Hearts this year!

[b]IMPORTANT: [/b]Pivot of Hearts is still under heavy development and this updates includes several dialogue changes. As such, expect your saves from the previous demo version (0.11.4) to not be compatible anymore. Saves will become reliably stable only once the full game is released.

The highlights for this update are:

[list]
[*] A new special scene at the end with a preview of content from the full game
[*] Scene animations 100% complete
[*] Music and sound 100% complete
[*] Card choices fully balanced
[*] Several UX improvements
[/list]

We are finally reaching the end of a long journey developing Pivot of Hearts. Thank you for playing the demo and stay tuned for a release date announcement in the near future!

[h2]Detailed CHANGELOG[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadow to all cards in the UI
[*] Smooth entering animation to phone messages
[*] Call out to play full game in credits
[*] Government support in credits
[*] New contributions in credits
[*] Luna preview of full game in final scene
[*] Side image support for Luna
[*] Three new speech SFX variations, which some characters now use
[*] Lipflapping in all scenes
[*] Missing suit hints
[*] Several SFXs and ambiences to scenes throughout the game
[*] Quadrilha BGM
[*] "Cul Convidativo" BGM
[*] Real chapter title shown in save slots
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Choice rephrased in Cauã's tour to showcase Wen's irony
[*] First flashback tweaked to better differentiate suit choices
[*] First flashback tweaked to clarify player's choices cannot be changed
[*] Luna's intro BGM set to pick up from title menu GBM
[*] Credits scenes remade with a typical "rolling" animation
[*] Copyright notice updated in title screen to include 2025
[*] Luna's intro updated to reflect current state of the game
[*] Subway logos replaced
[*] Support logos in splash screen adjusted to conform to new LPG grant
[*] Shiryuu phone strap replaced by a full remake
[*] Present card in 1st dream replaced by king of clubs
[*] Work colleague names with short version inside speeches
[*] Suit scores and love points balance for an appropriate level of challenge
[*] Suit award animation extended to allow gaining multiple points
[*] Different text emphasis formats in the game more consistently applied
[*] Audio dynamics implemented throughout several scenes
[*] Sprite animations adjusted to be more stable
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Save slots not being translated
[*] Build sometimes including scenes from the full game
[*] Copyright notice so it starts based on the first commit
[*] Minor inconsistencies in character sprites
[*] Formatting in all scenes
[*] Card panel being in wrong state in some scenes
[*] Missing lipflapping animation for some character expressions
[*] "Indícios" BGM looping in karaoke scene
[*] Several typos
[/list]

notes.title: Demo patch 0.10.2
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/763487120999710752/1182463511541055488/pivot-release-0.10.2.gif?ex=6584c9f6&is=657254f6&hm=c3691261546c16031e5f930bc23563768340911454fab9b14135de9e4f3531df&[/img]
Progress on Pivot of Hearts is slow but steady, we are on our way to finish three out of four chapters.

However, we also did several improvements to the game as a whole and we think the demo deserves some love as well. As such, this patch backports these improvements for all of you to enjoy while playing our free demo ;)

Here are the main changes:

[list]
[*]Added[list]
[*]Experimental lip-flapping support (only in one place for now - can you find it?)
[*]More Wén sprite expressions
[*]Bárbara's sillouette when she send voice messages in first scene (see gif above!)
[*]Expression variations to Artist Ana's sprites
[*]Cool SFX now play when characters speak
[/list]
[*]Changed[list]
[*]Assets and scene scripts are now packaged for reduced build size
[*]Make most text pauses in Chapter 1 end automatically after a delay
[*]Bárbara's tarot tutorial options become hidden after you choose them
[*]Tutorial order can be chosen by player
[*]Transition animations changed to real dates instead of "Week X"
[*]Frames for card animations replaced with smaller resolution to load faster
[/list]
[*]Fixed[list]
[*]Some sprites with graphical issues
[*]Dozens of typos and other minor mistakes
[*]"Indícios" BGM not looping as it should
[*]All clocks and time references
[*]Crashes on flashback scene
[*]Going back from drop-down menu wrongly taking you to pause menu
[*]Missing translations for suit tooltips
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Brazilian-Portuguese patch available!
notes.content:
This is the much awaited Brazilian-Portuguese patch for the Pivot of Hearts demo! You can now play the entire demo in the same language the characters of the story speak ;)

There are also some internal improvements that shouldn't change the usual gameplay experience, but that make our lives much easier! XD

notes.title: Demo patch 0.7.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41615395/015d8be30a2aa781f3c13f48a49658e7dd953b7e.gif[/img]
Here's the first patch for the demo of Pivot of Hearts, version 0.7.0!!

The highlights among the changes are:

[list]
[*] New cursor
[*] New animations when characters win or lose love points!
[*] Fixes to keyboard and gamepad UI navigation
[*] Fix crash when seeing a phone chat during auto  mode
[*] And a few other minor corrections here and there =)
[/list]

We would like to thank everyone who sent us feedback and bug reports! If you haven't played the demo yet, now is a great time to try out this enhanced version!

The next patches should include even more quality-of-life upgrades and a Brazilian Portuguese localization!
